Identified as this saint because: Titled and described on Commons as “Gregor Palamas”, filed under “Gregory Palamas in icons” and “15th-century icons of Byzantine Empire”; the artist is recorded as a North Greek (Thessalonican) master of the early 15th century — a near-contemporary icon of the 14th-century archbishop of Thessalonica.
